QuestInfo.name: [Gollux] Superior Gollux Pendant Exchange!
QuestInfo.0: For heroes who have been using 2 or more Superior Gollux Pendants, I'm exchanging one Superior Gollux Pendant for one Superior Gollux Belt! For the stats you gained from enhancing that Superior Gollux Pendant, any stats that can be applied to a belt will be transferred. If you're interested, now's your chance!\r\n* For details, such as which stats transfer, eligibility rules, etc., please refer to the announcement on the website.
